llmslim.description: Long-term memory for Claude Code with no LLM call. Stores messages word for word in local SQLite (or Postgres) and recalls the ones that answer a question within a token budget; fit_context shrinks long text to a budget. Tools: remember, recall, list_memories, forget, fit_context. The user and agent scope is fixed when the server starts, not chosen by the model. No API key. Runs with uvx (needs uv), or install with pip install "llmslim[mcp]" and run llmslim mcp. MIT.
